product: Value lists for AI/BI dashboard parameters are generally available
tagline: You can add a value list to a SQL dataset or local metric view parameter so that viewers pick from a fixed, ordered set of values in the parameter's filter.
what_it_does: You can add a value list to a SQL dataset or local metric view parameter so that viewers pick from a fixed, ordered set of values in the parameter's filter. Add the list in the Value section of the Parameter details dialog. Viewers can still enter any value that fits the parameter's type.
why_it_matters: Dataset field filters can also offer dashboard interactivity, more features, and better performance with large datasets than parameters.
